summary: Full E2E of Signature Loyalty Card (gold stamp card). Backend: 12/13 tests pass (1 skipped by public rate-limit — expected). Frontend: settings card saves ✦, public booking widget confirmed by main-agent screenshot (429 during my re-test — expected), POS gold stamp card renders + Add-stamp works + Redeem correctly hidden when no reward available. Restaurant tenant correctly rejected with 400. Auto-stamp via POST /api/invoices confirmed +1 stamp.
critical_code_review_comments: loyalty_stamps.py _find_cust: phone regex uses last 10 digits with $ anchor — a 10-digit collision between +91 prefixed and other formats is safe, but the query is NOT tenant-scoped (no tenant_id filter). If the same phone exists in two tenants, the staff-authenticated add/redeem could pick the wrong tenant's customer. Fix: add `tenant_id: user['tenant_id']` (or equivalent) to the query.

loyalty_stamps.py public_view_card: rate-limit per phone key is `phone:{digits}:stamps:{day}` — this is per-phone GLOBAL across tenants. If the same phone books at 2 salons, one guest checking their own card in salon B still counts against the same daily quota. Consider scoping by tenant slug.

loyalty_stamps.py: raw_stamps grows unbounded; after many redeems `stamps % needed` wraps correctly, but if admin later reduces `stamps_needed` (e.g. 12→3) then `stamps // needed - redeemed` can jump to a large positive number and instantly grant multiple rewards. Suggest capping rewards_available or freezing on setting change.
add_stamp_manual has no idempotency / rate limit — a staff member (or compromised staff cookie) can hammer the endpoint. Consider a small server-side throttle per (staff, customer) e.g. max 3/min.

StampCard.jsx: on redeem success the toast says 'apply X% off in the discount field' — no automatic linkage to the invoice discount input, so staff must manually type it (documented UX but easy to forget). Consider auto-filling the overall-discount field.
seed_data_creation: Created ~4 TEST_ prefixed customers (random 10-digit phones starting 6/7/8/9) during backend tests. Phone 9787537706 has +1 extra stamp (was 3, now 4) from the POS UI add-stamp click. Loyalty settings left ENABLED with stamps_needed=5, reward_label='Free Hair Spa', discount_pct=100 as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter118_loyalty_stamps.py — covers settings validation (2-12 stamps, 80-char reward, restaurant 400), manual add/redeem, full-card redeem, auto-stamp via invoice creation, public lookup format guard. Run with `pytest ... -o addopts=''` because backend/pytest.ini forces xdist and this file is fine but the addopts differ per repo config. Public loyalty endpoint is rate-limited 5/10min per IP — expect 429 skips on re-runs. POS TEST Cust phone 9787537706 currently at 4 stamps (1 more for reward).
